description_expanded:
Seagrove Beach

900 Steps to San Juan Beach Access

Private heated pool with spillover spa!

Artful, elegant décor, custom finishes

Outdoor fireplace for cozy evenings

Putting green

6-Seater Golf cart!

Fun shops and fine dining

Tickled Pink by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Freshly built and full of charm, Tickled Pink is a bright, custom-designed beach house, just a short stroll from the beach! Set in the heart of Seagrove, the five spacious bedrooms, smart layout, and elegant décor provide a clean coastal vibe and a fun-loving spirit. It’s easy to chill here, this is coastal living at its finest. Out back? A poolside paradise. Lounge by the private heated pool, soak in the spillover spa, or challenge the crew to a round on the putting green. The outdoor fireplace adds the perfect touch for breezy evenings. Inside, two living areas offer room to spread out, and the sleek kitchen is fully equipped and wide open, perfect for waffle mornings, cocktail hours, and everything in between. A golf cart is included for easy cruising around Seagrove’s shops, trails, and beach paths.

Celebrating something special or simply sneaking away to soak in the 30A lifestyle? Tickled Pink is where unforgettable vacations begin. At Oversee 30A, we’re local, attentive, and always nearby if you need us. Our team is here every day to help make your stay smooth, fun, and completely stress-free. Tickled Pink is ready when you are. Overview: - New construction - Private pool w/ spillover spa (pool can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Putting green - Complimentary golf cart - 900 Steps to the beach (San Juan Beach Access) - 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths - WIFI - 5 Bikes - Parking for 4 vehicles comfortably Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Suite: King bed, en-suite bath, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Suite: King bed, en-suite bath, TV - Guest Suite: Two Queen beds, en-suite bath, TV - Guest Suite: Two Twin beds, en-suite bath, TV - Guest Suite: Two Twin bunk beds, en-suite bath, TV - Twin Bunk Nook Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
